topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by introducing the hallmarks of cancer framework, the multistep progression model, and the learning objectives.

topics.label: Sustaining proliferative signaling and evading growth suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in pathways such as Wnt/beta-catenin and receptor tyrosine kinases drive autonomous cell proliferation and override growth-inhibitory signals.

topics.label: Block to terminal differentiation in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how differentiation arrests prevent cells from exiting the cell cycle and maturing, using examples from hematologic malignancies and colorectal epithelium.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis through p53 and Bcl-2 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through alterations in p53 surveillance and the balance of pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, senescence bypass, and growth control summary
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the mechanics of telomere shortening, senescence triggers, telomerase reactivation, and p53 stress integration, concluding the section on intrinsic growth control hallmarks.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells rewire their metabolic pathways via aerobic glycolysis and acquire mutations in metabolic enzymes that alter the epigenome.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the requirement for new blood vessel growth to sustain tumor expansion and the regulatory switch between angiogenic activators and inhibitors.

topics.label: Mechanisms, monitoring, and genetics of invasion and metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the biological cascade of metastatic dissemination, the use of liquid biopsies for longitudinal tracking, the seed-and-soil paradigm, and associated genomic features.

topics.label: Summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture with concluding reflections on cancer hallmark integration and final housekeeping remarks.
